name: Between the Shrouded Peaks
source:
BtSP is a furry dating simulator that takes place in a remote high mountain town. The player has to navigate decisions surrounding both the town's past and future amid impending financial and supernatural crises.

[From [url=https://zyyphelze.itch.io/between-the-shrouded-peaks]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
BtSP是一款毛茸茸的约会模拟器，故事发生在一个偏远的高山小镇。在迫在眉睫的金融和超自然危机中，玩家必须围绕小镇的过去和未来做出决定。

[来自[url=https://zyyphelze.itch.io/between-the-shrouded-peaks]Itch.io[/url]]
